name: cli-session-caller-controlled-durability
body:
`apg session save` makes durable everything buffered since the previous save: one atomic write of the buffered node files into `apg/layers/<layer>/<type>/<name>.json`, one git commit, and the scan_meta re-anchor. After the flush the buffer is empty, and a `save` over an empty buffer is a noop.

ACCEPTANCE:
- A `save` after a run of N accepted mutations writes every buffered node file and lands exactly one git commit plus the scan_meta re-anchor, and the buffer empties.
- A `save` issued over an empty buffer writes nothing and lands no commit.
- A run of N buffered mutations followed by one save produces the same on-disk state as N save-after-each-mutation runs, with one commit.
